verdict.rationale: Portkey's dedicated fallbacks docs describe configuring a prioritized list of providers/models with automatic fallback to the next target when the primary fails. Fallback triggers on any non-2xx status by default, and on_status_codes lets you customize the trigger. Supporting features include per-strategy circuit protection, retries, and filtering logs by Config ID to observe fallback behavior. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that fallback works as documented in production.
